title: triticum dicoccum subsp. atratum
intro: Triticum dicoccum subsp. atratum, commonly known as Spelt wheat, is an ancient type of wheat that belongs to the Triticum genus. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for centuries for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Spelt wheat include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Spelt wheat include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and dietary fibers, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
